census_sql:
WITH selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_accepted_companies_v1
), docs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.company_id, c.selection_order, c.anchor_ticker, m.accession_number,
         m.form_type, m.filing_date, m.report_date, m.cik, d.file_id,
         d.document_sha256, octet_length(d.raw_document) AS bytes,
         'financial-document-v1:' || encode(sha256(convert_to(
           jsonb_build_array(m.accession_number,d.file_id,d.document_sha256)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS document_key
  FROM selected c
  JOIN research_eq10_fundamental_pit_20261020.financial_filing_metadata_v1 m
    ON c.company_id = 'CIK:' || lpad(m.cik,10,'0')
  JOIN research_eq10_fundamental_pit_20261020.financial_documents_v1 d USING(accession_number)
  WHERE m.form_type IN ('10-Q','10-K')
    AND m.filing_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    AND d.file_id = regexp_replace(m.raw_payload->>'main_file_url','^.*/','')
), pending AS (
  SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY company_id ORDER BY filing_date DESC,accession_number DESC,file_id) rn
  FROM docs d
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_admission_v1 a
    WHERE a.document_key = d.document_key
  ) AND bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608
)
SELECT c.company_id,c.anchor_ticker,c.selection_order,coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) FILTER (WHERE d.company_id IS NOT NULL),'[]') retained_main_documents, CASE WHEN count(d.company_id)=0 THEN 'NO_MATCH_IN_THIS_RETAINED_MAIN_DOCUMENT_CENSUS_NOT_PROOF_OF_NO_FILING' ELSE 'RETAINED_MATCH_NOT_FAMILY_OR_TEMPORAL_ACCEPTANCE' END state FROM selected c LEFT JOIN docs d ON d.company_id=c.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id,c.anchor_ticker,c.selection_order ORDER BY c.selection_order;
